video_title: Everyone's High On The Spurs, But What About the Thunder? | Chris Mannix & Grant Liffmann

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: The Thunder's improved health and depth make them a serious contender
quotes.excerpt: I'm seeing a healthy AJ Mitchell, a healthy Jaylen Williams, Chet Holmgren with another off-season, and Shai.
quotes.quote: I'm looking around at Oklahoma City, and I'm seeing a healthy AJ Mitchell, who wasn't healthy in the conference finals. I'm seeing a healthy Jaylen Williams, who wasn't healthy in the playoffs. I'm seeing Chet Holmgren with another off-season. I'm seeing Shai still in his prime. Yeah, they lost some guys, but I think they can replace Lou Dort adequately with Cason Wallace and all the guys they have on the wing. Same thing with Aaron Wiggins, who was an auxiliary guy for that team the last couple of years. I think he's going to be really good in Atlanta. Should they be considered right there as 1A in the Western Conference alongside San Antonio?

quotes.speaker: Grant Liffmann
quotes.summary_phrase: OKC and San Antonio are the top contenders in the West
quotes.excerpt: I could make an argument right now that OKC should be favored above San Antonio too.

text_blocks.speaker: Grant Liffmann
text_blocks.text: I could make an argument right now that OKC should be favored above San Antonio too. I'm not saying it's necessarily true of 1A, 1B. I think just Victor Wembanyama's growth, if he gets any better, he's the best player in the world, so of course you want to hand it to San Antonio at that point. But OKC, I would have to search for a weakness. And if anything I can think of, is their wing position depth is a little weak. That's it.

text_blocks.speaker: Chris Mannix
text_blocks.text: Can Oklahoma City beat the Spurs when Victor Wembanyama does to Chet Holmgren what he did last series, last playoffs?

text_blocks.speaker: Grant Liffmann
text_blocks.text: They need more. I could not agree more. That is a massive, massive storyline. But I cannot stress enough, a healthy Jalen Williams can counteract the offense that Chet wasn't bringing. Chet was the number two scorer pretty much, or supposed to be, their second option when Jalen was hurt and Chet wasn't scoring against Victor. So if Victor is eliminating Chet, which is horrible for OKC, that is a huge issue. But I cannot stress enough, a healthy Jalen Williams playing at top level, you're talking about an All-Star.

quotes.speaker: Grant Liffmann
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's development is a key factor for the Thunder
quotes.excerpt: Dylan Harper is now a year older. Dylan Harper is an absolute stud.
quotes.quote: Dylan Harper is now a year older. Dylan Harper is an absolute stud. So let's talk about development for other teams too, right? If Jalen Williams is going to be back and playing well, then what about Dylan Harper being better? I just, I love it. It's incredible. These two teams bring the drama that you absolutely just crave.

quotes.speaker: Grant Liffmann
quotes.summary_phrase: San Antonio's lack of elite shooting is their main weakness
quotes.excerpt: If I'm talking about a weakness of San Antonio, I would say they don't have elite shooting.
quotes.quote: If I'm talking about a weakness of San Antonio, I would say they don't have elite shooting. They have good shooters. Jeremy Sochan can make some shots. Harrison Barnes can hit some corner shots. But majority of their players, the guys that they rely on out there, Devin Vassell is a good shooter, they don't have any of those elite, elite shooters. And I do wonder, and that's why I kind of craved maybe instead of Tobias Harris, I want them to get someone like a Rui Hachimura to put in the corner, one of those guys who shoot like 45% from three, or put another, you know, unbelievable shooter like a Kentavious Caldwell-Pope or somebody out there that can also get a little bit more spacing.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: OKC's perimeter shooting and AJ Mitchell's breakout potential
quotes.excerpt: I don't think Oklahoma City is going to have any problem with perimeter shooting.
quotes.quote: I don't think Oklahoma City is going to have any problem with perimeter shooting. Shai can still knock it down. Jared McCain is going to get more minutes with Lou Dort gone. AJ Mitchell, I talked to AJ Mitchell for a while earlier in this week and to your point, they are expecting a breakout type of season. Last year was a breakout year. Year two, breakout year for AJ Mitchell. They think he can get to an All-Star level this year.
